The TRD's lifecycle table states a tracked record is filed on every close, which --file-and-close does not do, and the .local writer pin accepts an orphaned writer - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

Conformance re-derives a closed unit's risk band from today's tree, so a later unit's edit to a shared file fails a light APPROVE that was right when given, and the census names the wrong remedy - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
A command to amend a planned unit's Affects or a criterion in flight, recording why, so a builder's scope finding is not a hand edit - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)

doc_freshness's baseline leg has no pin for checking every Coverage line, nor for skipping the revision history - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
The commit hook's unittest fallback ignores pytest's serial_only and boundary_only marks, so a push-only test still runs on a commit there - not-stop-ship, ruled by Darren Benson (operator)
